input.answer: If I have to pick, I'd take the second drawing, where each company like הראל or מור gets its own heading with its fees "מ־0.54% עד 0.61%" next to the name, because I can see straight away who they are and what they charge. But the whole page is dark, full of numbers and English letters, and I'd ask you before I trusted any of it.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the three buttons '1. החברה בראש השורה', '2. קיבוץ לפי חברה', '3. טבלת חברות מול סוגים'
stuck.why: I didn't understand what each one meant, so I just scrolled. Only later did I work out that the page shows the drawings one after another.
It opens with 'עוקב מדד s&p 500' and 'מניות 99%'. That's shares and English letters, which nearly made me leave. I couldn't find anything safe like a deposit.
It looked the same as the first one again, so it took me a while to see it was a different drawing, grouped by company.
I got tired here. It's dark and full of numbers, so I never reached the third drawing, the one they marked 'מומלץ'.

findings.what: The whole page is white and grey text on a black background, and much of it is small and pale. It's hard to read even with my glasses and the screen enlarged.
The first thing in the list is 'עוקב מדד s&p 500' and 'מניות 99%'. To me that says shares and gambling, and it almost made me leave.
I couldn't see that the three buttons were different drawings. On the page they look almost the same, a long table repeated.
Every row has too many numbers: fees, the fund number, percentages, rings, years, billions. It makes me anxious.
The grey heading row for each company is the most useful thing, because it shows the company and the range of its fees in one line.
The 'מומלץ' drawing is so far down that I never got to it.
English letters and terms like מט"ח and עוקב מדד are never explained.
There are two fees, 'מהחיסכון' and 'מההפקדה', and nothing tells me what that comes to in shekels for me.
